context: Four cousins gather for Sho's birthday. Big family celebration.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: しょう、誕生日、おめでとう！
lines.style: Warm, genuine smile in the voice. Bright opening with soft emphasis on the name. Sincere, unhurried—the kind of warmth that doesn't perform for an audience, just lands naturally.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: おめでとう、しょうくん！もう、九歳ね。
lines.style: Affectionate, slightly amazed at how fast time moves. Warm undertone. The second sentence carries a touch of tender wonder, not rushed. Gentle throughout.

lines.speaker: hina_child
lines.jp: しょうくん！プレゼント、ある！
lines.style: Bright, excited burst at the top. High energy but genuinely delighted, not theatrical. The words tumble out with childlike urgency and pure joy. Infectious without being shrill.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.style: Small, genuine awe underneath. A six-year-old touched by attention, voice warm and grateful. Slightly breathless—like he's taking it in. Soft and sincere, not performing gratitude.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: しょう、お兄ちゃんになる準備、ちゃんと、できてる？
lines.en: Sho, are you ready to be a big brother?
lines.style: Warm curiosity with a thread of gentle teasing. Asks the question as if genuinely invested in the answer. Soft, encouraging—checking in more than testing him.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.en: Yes… I will become a proper big brother.
lines.style: Quiet moment before the answer. Small but firm—you can hear the resolve in those words. Tender pride beneath the surface. Soft and deliberate, not rushed.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: しょう、本当に、立派な、お兄ちゃんに、なる。
lines.en: Sho, you'll become a truly wonderful big brother.
lines.style: Steady, believing. Not flattering—stating something she knows to be true. Warm, affirming. The words land with gentle weight. Sincere, unhurried.

lines.speaker: hina_child
lines.jp: ひな、お姉さんに、なるよ！
lines.style: Bright, announced with pure delight. High energy and open-hearted. Wants to be part of it, stakes her claim joyfully. Childlike enthusiasm, genuine and unguarded.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 皆で、赤ちゃん、迎えるね。
lines.en: We're all welcoming the baby together.
lines.style: Warm, inclusive. A moment of quiet togetherness in the voice. Gentle and grounding—gathering everyone into the same space. Soft, like saying something important without making it feel heavy.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 皆で、お祝いと、お祝いと、続くね。
lines.en: Celebration keeps coming one after another.
lines.style: Reflective, warm. A slightly wistful appreciation of how these moments stack up. Thoughtful pace, gentle—she's noticing something beautiful about the continuity.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.style: Quiet, deeply felt. Small voice but unguarded—this matters. Tender opening, the words soft and honest. No performance, just truth spoken gently into the room.

lines.speaker: hina_child
lines.jp: 皆で、誕生日、毎年、お祝いしようね！
lines.en: Let's celebrate all our birthdays together every year!
lines.style: Bright, hopeful declaration. A child's certainty that this will happen forever. Earnest and open, reaching outward. High energy but grounded in genuine warmth and want.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 絶対、ね。皆で、ずっと、一緒に。
lines.en: Absolutely. All of us, forever, together.
lines.style: Quiet promise underneath. Warm, steady, and certain. Gentle but unshakeable. The kind of thing you say and mean—no rush, just presence and commitment held in those simple words.
